syllabus.title: General Science (5 Questions in Group 4 / GS Standard)
syllabus.topics: Nature of Universe - Measurement of physical quantities - Scientific laws in motion, force, pressure, energy - Everyday applications of mechanics, electricity, magnetism, light, sound, heat, nuclear physics - Elements, compounds, acids, bases, salts, petroleum products, fertilizers, pesticides - Main concepts of life science, genetics, physiology, nutrition, human diseases - Environmental science - Latest inventions in science & technology - Current affairs.

syllabus.title: Geography (5 Questions in Group 4 / GS Standard)
syllabus.topics: Earth location - Physical features - Monsoon, rainfall, weather, climate - Water resources, rivers, soil, minerals - Forest & wildlife - Agriculture pattern - Transport & communication - Population density & distribution in TN & India - Calamities, disaster management - Climate change - Geographical landmarks - Current affairs.

syllabus.title: History, Culture of India & Indian National Movement (10 Questions)
syllabus.topics: Indus Valley Civilization - Guptas, Delhi Sultans, Mughals, Marathas - South Indian History - National Renaissance - Early uprisings against British rule - Indian National Congress - Emergence of leaders (Ambedkar, Bhagat Singh, Bharathiar, VOC, Periyar, Nehru, Kamarajar, Gandhi, Rajaji, Subhash Chandra Bose, Muthulakshmi Ammaiyar, Muvalur Ramamirtham) - Freedom agitations of TN - Characteristics of Indian Culture, Unity in Diversity.

syllabus.title: Indian Polity (15 Questions)
syllabus.topics: Constitution of India - Preamble - Salient features - Citizenship, Fundamental Rights, Fundamental Duties, DPSP - Union Executive & Legislature - State Executive & Legislature - Local Governments & Panchayat Raj - Federalism & Centre-State relations - Election & Judiciary - Rule of Law - Anti-corruption, Lokpal & Lokayukta - RTI - Women Empowerment - Human Rights - Political system in TN & India.

syllabus.title: Indian Economy & Development Administration in Tamil Nadu (20 Questions)
syllabus.topics: Nature of Indian Economy - Five-year plans - Niti Aayog - Reserve Bank of India - Finance Commission - GST - Employment generation, land reforms, agriculture science - Industrial growth - Rural welfare programmes - Education & Health systems in TN - Social justice & social harmony - Geography of TN & economic growth - Government welfare schemes - Current socio-economic issues.

syllabus.title: History, Culture, Heritage & Socio-Political Movements of Tamil Nadu (20 Questions)
syllabus.topics: History of Tamil Society & archaeological discoveries - Tamil literature from Sangam age till contemporary times - Thirukkural (Secular literature, universal values, socio-political relevance, philosophical content) - Role of Tamil Nadu in freedom struggle - Role of women in freedom struggle - Social reform movements & social transformation of Tamil Nadu.

syllabus.title: Part B: Aptitude and Mental Ability (SSLC Standard – 25 Questions)
syllabus.topics:
Unit I: Aptitude (15 Qs): Simplification, Percentage, HCF & LCM, Ratio & Proportion, Simple Interest, Compound Interest, Area, Volume, Time & Work.
Unit II: Reasoning (10 Qs): Logical reasoning, Puzzles, Dice, Visual reasoning, Alpha numeric reasoning, Number series.

syllabus.title: Part C: தமிழ் தகுதி மற்றும் மதிப்பீட்டுத் தேர்வு (SSLC Standard - 100 Questions)
syllabus.topics:
அலகு I: இலக்கணம் (25 Qs) - பிரித்து/சேர்த்து எழுதுதல், சந்திப்பிழை, ல/ள/ழ, ன/ண, ர/ற வேறுபாடு, சுட்டு/வினா எழுத்துக்கள், வேர்ச்சொல், தொழிற் பெயர், வினையெச்சம்.
அலகு II: சொல்லகராதி (15 Qs) - எதிர்ச்சொல், அகரவரிசைப்படி சீர்செய்தல், மரூஉச் சொற்கள் (புதுச்சேரி->புதுவை), பிழை திருத்துதல் (ஒரு/ஓர், வெற்றிலை).
அலகு III: எழுதும் திறன் (15 Qs) - செய்வினை, செயப்பாட்டு வினை, தன்வினை, பிறவினை, திணை/பால் மரபு, நிறுத்தற்குறிகள்.
அலகு IV: கலைச் சொற்கள் (10 Qs) - search engine (தேடு பொறி), Migration (வலசை), Allergy (ஒவ்வாமை), Gene (மரபணு), Nautical Mile (கடல் மைல்).
அலகு V: வாசித்தல் (15 Qs) - பத்தி வினாக்கள், உவமைத் தொடர், பழமொழிகள்.
அலகு VI: எளிய மொழிபெயர்ப்பு (5 Qs) - pendrive, printer, computer, keyboard.
அலகு VII: இலக்கியம் & தமிழ் சான்றோர்கள் (15 Qs) - திருக்குறள் (20 அதிகாரங்கள்), நாலடியார், உ.வே.சா, தேவநேயப் பாவாணர், ஜி.யு.போப், வீரமாமுனிவர், பாரதிதாசன், கண்ணதாசன், காமராஜர், காயிதே மில்லத், வேலுநாச்சியார்.

syllabus.title: Part C Alternative: General English (SSLC Standard - 100 Questions)
syllabus.topics:
Unit I: Grammar (25 Qs) - Parts of speech, Concord, Tense, Voice, Sentences, Verbs, Question tags.
Unit II: Vocabulary (15 Qs) - Synonyms, Antonyms, Homonyms, Idioms, Phrasal verbs, One word substitution.
Unit III: Writing Skills (10 Qs) - Letter writing, Jumbled sentences.
Unit IV: Technical Terms (10 Qs) - Administrative & department terms.
Unit V: Reading Comprehension (20 Qs) - Passages, Headlines, Sentence completion.
Unit VI: Translation (5 Qs) - Word & sentence translation.
Unit VII: Literary Works (15 Qs) - Poems (Robert Frost, Emily Dickinson, Tupac Shakur) & Prose (Liam O'Flaherty, C.V. Raman, Ramanujan, Nehru).

syllabus.title: Specialized Units: HR&CE Saivam & Vaishnavam / Forest Science
syllabus.topics:
Hindu Religion (சைவமும் வைணவமும்): சைவ ஆகமங்கள், 12 திருமுறைகள், 4000 திவ்ய பிரபந்தம், கோயில் நிர்வாக சட்டங்கள் (HR&CE Act 1959).

faqs.q: What are the 8 Exam Groups in TNPSC?
faqs.a:
TNPSC conducts recruitment under 8 major group categories:
1. Group 1: Premier State Administrative Services (Deputy Collector, DSP)
2. Group 2 & 2A: Executive & Non-Executive Posts (Sub-Registrar, RI)
3. Group 3 & 3A: Subordinate Services (Junior Inspector)
4. Group 4 & VAO (Code: 496): Village Administrative Officer, Junior Assistant, Typist, Steno
5. Group 5A: Assistant Section Officer in TN Secretariat
6. Group 6: Assistant Conservator of Forests (ACF)
7. Group 7B & 8: Executive Officer Grade III & IV in HR&CE Department
8. Group 7A: Executive Officer Grade I in HR&CE Department

faqs.q: What is the qualification and exam pattern for TNPSC Group 4 (Code 496)?
faqs.a:
Qualification: SSLC (10th Pass). Pattern: Single OMR written test of 3 Hours with 200 Questions (300 Marks):
• Part A: General Studies (75 Qs)
• Part B: Aptitude & Mental Ability (25 Qs)
• Part C: General Tamil Eligibility-cum-Scoring Test (100 Qs) or General English.

faqs.q: Is General Tamil compulsory for TNPSC Examinations?
faqs.a: Yes! Tamil Eligibility Test is mandatory across all TNPSC examinations. In Group 4 and Group 2 Prelims, Part C consists of 100 General Tamil questions that directly count towards your merit score.

faqs.q: Can final year college students apply for Group 1 and Group 2?
faqs.a: Candidates must possess the required degree qualification on or before the date of official notification release to be eligible to apply.
